artworks.title: Indian Tobacco Shop Sign [reverse, Indian facing right]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a person in profile standing upright and facing to the right. The individual has dark brown skin, long black hair, and wears a headdress made of colorful leaves. They hold a cylindrical object with a yellow ribbon in their left hand. The person wears a red garment with black markings and geometric patterns, along with tan pants and moccasin-like shoes. They also wear a yellow necklace around their neck. The background is a plain, solid light color.

artworks.title: Catalyntje Post
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a full-length portrait. She has a pale complexion, arched eyebrows, a small mouth, and dark eyes. She wears a cap, a red and gold dress with white lace detailing, and floral patterns. Her shoes are visible beneath the dress, and she wears a pearl necklace. She holds a dark object in one hand and has the other hand on her waist. The background is dark with flowers on the left and a pattern of roses on the right.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man in Red
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, sitting with his body slightly facing left and his head turned towards the viewer. He has a long face, defined features, fair complexion, and dark hair framing his face and extending to his shoulders with a straight fringe across his forehead. He is wearing a red coat with gold buttons over a white high-collared shirt, holding a closed book in his right hand. The background is plain with earthy tones and a subtle texture, emphasizing the figure. A dark chair is partially visible behind him on the left side of the image.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Lady in Red
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, facing the viewer directly with her upper body slightly turned to the left. She has a serene expression and light-colored eyes with a soft, closed-mouth smile. Her hair is styled with flowers and pearls, and she is wearing a dark red gown with lace trim. She has a black ribbon tied around her neck in a bow and is holding a pink flower in her hands. The background is a textured, muted green.

artworks.title: Sisters
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a bust-length portrait of two young girls positioned side by side, occupying the left and right halves of the canvas. Both girls are facing forward, with their bodies angled slightly inward toward each other. They have pale complexions with prominent facial features; the girl on the left has large brown eyes, while the girl on the right has striking blue eyes. Their hair is styled in long, dark brown, tightly-coiled ringlets that fall to their shoulders, with a slight part in the middle. Both are wearing dark-colored dresses with wide, off-the-shoulder necklines that reveal their collarbones and bare necks. The background is a plain, light beige color, offering no additional context or embellishments. There are no visible pieces of jewelry or objects in their hands.

artworks.title: Bowl of Fruit
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Mother and Child in White
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman seated with a young child on her lap. The woman is holding the child securely with one arm wrapped around the child and the other holding a small flower. The woman has a fair complexion, an oval face, straight dark eyebrows, light-colored eyes, and is wearing a bonnet with lace and a large blue ribbon. She is dressed in a light-colored gown with a high neckline, a black choker, and a wide black belt. The child, also fair-complexioned, is wearing a dress with a blue sash and a lacy bonnet. They sit against a dark background.

artworks.title: Young Woman with a Butterfly
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a young woman seated on an ornate yellow-brown chair, with her body slightly turned to the left and her head facing us. She has fair skin, dark wavy hair, a long nose, pale eyebrows, and small red lips that are slightly turned up at the ends. She is wearing a white gown with wide sleeves and a light greenish-yellow cloth draped over her shoulder and legs, perhaps a smock or apron, secured over her other shoulder by a beaded strap. She is holding a small sprig of greenery in her right hand, which rests on an arm of the chair, and her left hand is outstretched towards a round red vase on the right of the painting filled with flowers in shades of pink, cream, and pale yellow, with large green leaves. Two butterflies float above her hand in shades of cream and pale red. Her feet are visible below the hem of her dress, resting on the ground near the bottom right corner. The background features a dark red draped curtain that comes down from the top left corner and appears to cover most of the chair she sits on. The wall behind her and the colorful flowers is dark, with one section in the top right corner appearing to show a sliver of light blue sky with pink clouds.

artworks.title: The Domino Girl
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a young person sitting at a table, holding a box in one hand and arranging dominoes with the other. They have short brown hair with a straight fringe and are wearing a white dress with wide sleeves and a pink sash. The person has fair skin, dark eyebrows, and dark eyes. The background includes a window showing trees and a partly cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Girl with Kitten
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body portrait of a young child standing indoors. The child faces forward with a neutral expression, looking directly at the viewer. They have neatly styled brown hair parted in the middle. The child wears a white dress with lace detailing at the collar and puffed short sleeves, over layered pantaloons. The dress has intricate patterns along the hem. They hold a bunch of flowers in their left hand and a red ribbon in their right hand, which trails down to the floor. A small cat playfully touches the end of the ribbon near the child's feet. The child wears white socks and black shoes. The background consists of a green-tinted wall and wooden floor, with a window on the left showing a glimpse of the sky with foliage and a warm sunset hue.

artworks.title: Basket of Fruit with Flowers
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch

artworks.title: Dr. Philemon Tracy
artworks.medium: oil on paper on board on canvas
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man depicted from the waist up. He is seated in a chair, with his body turned slightly to the right and his gaze directed forward. The man's facial features are distinct with a fair complexion, large dark eyes, and a straight nose. His hair is short and appears gray, with a slight part on one side. He is wearing a dark coat with white buttons, a blue waistcoat, a white shirt with a white cravat. He has one hand on his lap, while the other hand holds a letter or document. The background features a room with green vine and red flower wallpaper, and blue drapes. A window behind him shows a glimpse of a tree and water, suggesting an interior setting with an outside view.

artworks.title: Lady Wearing a Large White Cap
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: Shown from the waist up, a pale-skinned woman wearing a ruby-red dress and voluminous, pleated white headdress sits against a dark background in this vertical portrait painting. The woman’s body is angled to our right, but she looks at us from the corners of her dark gray eyes. She has thin eyebrows, lightly flushed cheeks, faintly smiling lips, and a wide, cleft chin over a slight double chin. A flesh-colored mole is just above the left corner of her mouth. Gray hair is swept up under the upside-down U-shaped headdress, which is pleated with translucent white fabric along the front and up and over the back. Another ribbon is solid white with a blue, red, and yellow floral pattern, and another is dotted with solid white against transparent fabric. The earring we see is a silver, ornate cross shape, and four strands of tiny pearls are tight to her neck like a choker. More translucent white cloth, now edged in ruffles, wraps around her neck and shoulders and is gathered under a bow tied with more of the floral-patterned ribbon. The vivid red dress has elbow-length sleeves with a looping gold design near the cuffs. White ruffles peek beyond the edges of the cuffs, and she wears a ring on the pinky finger of her left hand. The bodice is tightly fitting, and the skirt bunches up behind the woman in the wood chair, the back of which curves just beyond her right shoulder, to our left. She unfurls a scroll of music with one hand and holds the sheet with the other. Her left elbow, to our right, rests on the top of a narrow, black keyboard. The background is nearly black.

artworks.title: Dr. John Safford and Family
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals standing closely together in a line. On the left is a man in a dark blue coat with a gold emblem, beige trousers, and black shoes. Next to him is a woman in a black dress with a lace collar. In the center is a young boy in a brown suit with gilt buttons. To the right stands a young girl in a white dress with pink ribbons, and a taller woman in a similar dress holding a parasol. The background shows lush green trees and a clear blue sky.

artworks.title: Fruit and Baltimore Oriole
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: In this painting, a large half watermelon with vibrant red flesh and black seeds sits at the center of a white plate with a silver knife on top of it. Surrounding it on the long wooden table are various fruits, such as a yellow pineapple, red and green grapes, dark red plums, pink peaches, and a partially peeled orange. Below the table are some pumpkins or squash, as well as what could be figs or radishes. A yellow-and-black bird is perched on the handle of a yellow basket of mixed fruit placed behind the watermelon. Around the basket are white and pink flowers. In the background, on the left of the painting, a window reveals a scenic landscape featuring a winding river cutting through a green valley and dark, tree-filled hills below a light blue sky with faint pink clouds. The wall behind the table is a plain gray color.

artworks.title: On Point
artworks.creditLine: Courtesy Gwynne Garbisch McDevitt.  Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a dog with a white-and-brown coat standing in tall green grass. The dog has large eyes, a pointed snout, and long ears. It is looking intently at a group of small birds that stand at the bottom of the painting in an opening in the grass, situated between us and the dog. There are four birds, and they have brown-and-white feathers, orange eyes, and short beaks. The background features a blue sky with a few clouds, and the grass around the dog and birds is painted in different shades of green, yellow, and brown.

artworks.title: The Neigh of an Iron Horse
artworks.creditLine: Courtesy Gwynne Garbisch McDevitt.  Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: This painting shows a side view of a horse and a steam train in an open landscape. The reddish-brown horse is in the center of the painting, its legs bent and its head turned over its shoulder, looking to the left. Its long brown mane and tail appear to be blown to the left by the wind, and its one visible eye is wide, its mouth partially open. The gray-and-brown train is depicted in the background on the left, following a thin curving track, plumes of white and gray smoke flowing up from it. The color palette includes brown, green, blue, and white shades. The landscape contains tall grasses, small rocks, short bushes, a small blue pond on the left, and a tall tree on the right. The horizon is in the center, behind the horse, showing distant hazy trees and a cloudy blue sky above.

artworks.title: John Lothrop
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Edgar William and Bernice Chrysler Garbisch
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, facing slightly to the right. His fair complexion contrasts with short, dark brown hair that curls a little at the ends. He maintains direct eye contact with a neutral expression, and has distinct rounded cheeks. He wears formal attire with a white shirt, buttoned waistcoat, and deep orange overcoat with gold buttons. He sports a white cravat, elaborate ruffled cuffs, and his right hand is in his waistcoat. In the background, to the right, there is a shelf holding objects like a bound book and a quill in an inkwell. The backdrop is plain and brown.

artworks.title: Eliphalet Terry
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Charles Terry Butler

artworks.title: Lydia Coit Terry (Mrs. Eliphalet Terry)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Dr. Charles Terry Butler
artworks.description: The image shows the upper half of a seated woman, angled slightly to the side but facing forward. She has fair skin, rosy cheeks, dark brown curly hair, and wears a white lace cap with a lace collar over a dark garment. A red fabric is draped around her shoulders. The background is plain with an indistinct vertical line to the side.

artworks.title: The Ship "Favorite" Maneuvering Off Greenock
artworks.creditLine: Paul Mellon Collection
artworks.description: This painting depicts a maritime scene with several large sailing ships, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon is low in the painting, creating a wide expanse of sky above the ships and distant coastline with hills, trees, and a line of small buildings. In the center of the painting, a large ship faces the right, with several large white sails, blue flags, and red banners. One flag has the word "FAVORITE" visible as it ripples in the wind. Small people line the deck of this ship, and more people are visible in small row boats that float next to it. There are two other large ships to the left and right, as well as smaller rowboats and sailboats. The light blue sky is cloudy, and the water below the ships is pale green with soft white waves.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Grace Vogel Aldworth in memory of her grandparents Ralph and Mary Booth
artworks.description: A light-skinned woman wearing a lapis-blue dress sits on a throne, holding a nearly naked pale-skinned baby in this vertical painting. The woman’s long-sleeved dress falls in lively folds as it pools around her legs and feet. Curling tendrils frame her face while the rest of her brown hair is pulled back beneath a cloth headdress. Her body is angled to our left and she looks off just over our left shoulder. She supports the baby who straddles the right arm of the chair and balances on the toes of his right foot. With her right hand, the woman holds a piece of fruit, perhaps a small apple, up by the baby’s mouth. The throne sits low to the ground and is ornately carved and gilded with scrolling arms and intricate tracery up the back around the crimson-red, upholstered center. They sit in a room with a patterned tile floor, thick, brown stone walls, and a window with a view onto other buildings and people in the upper left corner. Three more apples rest on ledges near the window. A thick book lies open in the bottom right corner.

artworks.title: Still Life with Dead Game
artworks.creditLine: Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: Two roosters, a rabbit, and three small birds hang from the top of this vertical still life painting, so the heads of one white rooster and the rabbit come to rest on a dark stone ledge, about a third of the way up the composition. To our left, the tawny-brown rabbit’s nose faces us as the head rests on an azure-blue purse with silver lining. A pair of scissors is tucked behind the strap, which falls down over the ledge. To our right, the head of the rooster curves away with its red coxcomb coming toward us. A black fly rests on the rooster’s comb. The black tail feathers of another rooster arc out behind it, near the upper right corner of the painting. In front of the rabbit's bound, hind legs is a small bird with puffed, silvery-gray feathers, and one black leg tied up with a dark cord. To our left are two more small birds, one with gray, cream, and tan feathers, the other with cream, golden orange, and lapis blue. These two are secured with their beaks pointing upward. Two white and scarlet-red caps, falcon’s hoods, are strung up by white ribbon near the pair of birds. Below the ledge is a carved scene with nude or nearly nude people, but this area is mostly in shadow. Behind the animals is a dark, nearly black wall.

artworks.title: Seapiece: Off the French Coast
artworks.creditLine: Paul Mellon Collection
artworks.description: This painting shows a seascape with large sailboats on choppy blue-green waters. The horizon is in the bottom third of the painting, dividing the sea from the cloudy white-and-blue sky. The boats are seen from a distance, their tall sails in shades of white, cream, and tan. Small dots of color suggest people standing on the decks, but the details are unclear. Closer to us, some dark brown shapes emerge from the water; on the left are three vertical shapes that look like tree branches or driftwood, while on the right is a round object like a floating barrel. Around these objects are splashes of white waves, and in between them is a small V shape that could be a bird or the tail of a fish.
